scope.spin_definition: Physical right-handed bases about p and k1, density slash(p)(1+gamma5 slash(S))/2; metric +---; BMHV production.
scope.azimuth_definition: phi_S about p and phi_h about the standard jet axis relative to the hard production plane; retain photon L,X,Y until lepton contraction; see SCOPE.md.
scope.jet_algorithm: anti-kT, rapidity-azimuth distance, E-scheme standard axis; semi-inclusive with no extra-jet veto
scope.jet_approximation: Leading power small R and j_T/(p_JT R), from arXiv:2311.00672v2 Sec.3.1; finite matching required.
scope.momentum_region: j_T << p_JT R << p_JT ~ Q, p_JT R >> Lambda_QCD in Breit frame
scope.factorization_definition: Leading-power inclusive collinear hard production convolved with the standard-axis small-R semi-inclusive TMD fragmenting-jet function. Soft-subtracted symbolic TMD at zeta_J=(p_JT R)^2, explicit dx/x dz_J/z_J^2 and Breit measurement limits; a C0 J0 + a^2(C1 J0+C0 J1), a=alpha_s/(2Pi). Full native acceptance is reported separately.

Hqq.reason: Fresh physical-tagged spin-transfer Born, complete qgg/same/distinct real contributions and renormalized virtual interference; both dimensional MS convolutions and finite jet/TMD assembly are explicit.

Hqg.reason: Actual tagged amplitude traces vanish with open photon indices: odd-gamma chiral-odd trace.

Hqqbar.reason: Fresh tagged-antiquark interference is nonzero. Complete real-only dimensional coefficient starts at alpha_s squared, with no Born-hard times one-loop jet term at this order.

Hqqprime.reason: Actual tagged amplitude traces vanish with open photon indices: odd-gamma chiral-odd trace.
